        return a * a;
    }

    public static long distanceSquared(long ax, long ay, long bx, long by) {
        return square(ax - bx) + square(ay - by);
    }

    public static class Point {
        long x1, x2, x3, x4, x5;

        public Point(long x1, long x2, long x3, long x4, long x5) {
            this.x1 = x1;
            this.x2 = x2;
            this.x3 = x3;
            this.x4 = x4;
            this.x5 = x5;
        }

        private static long square(long x) {
            return x * x;
        }

            return square(x1) + square(x2) + square(x3) + square(x4) + square(x5);
        }

        public long dot(Point other) {
            return x1 * other.x1 + x2 * other.x2 + x3 * other.x3 + x4 * other.x4 + x5 * other.x5;
        }

        public Point subtract(Point other) {
            return new Point(x1 - other.x1, x2 - other.x2, x3 - other.x3, x4 - other.x4, x5 - other.x5);
        }
    }

    public static boolean check(ArrayList<Point> points, int index) {
        Point pivot = points.get(index);
        int size = points.size();
        for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
            if (j == index) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                if (k == index || k == j) continue;
                Point v1 = points.get(j).subtract(pivot);
                Point v2 = points.get(k).subtract(pivot);
                if (v1.dot(v2) > 0) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        InputReader reader = new InputReader(System.in);
        PrintWriter writer = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int n = reader.nextInt();

            writer.flush();
            writer.close();
            return;

        ArrayList<Point> points = new ArrayList<>(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

        }
        ArrayList<Integer> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (check(points, i)) {
                result.add(i + 1);
            }
        }
        writer.println(result.size());
        for (int idx : result) {

        }
        writer.flush();
        writer.close();
    }
